Grading Scale/Distribution:

The following grading system is used in this course:

A - High quality work

B - Good work

C - Satisfactory work

These grade symbols are translated into quality points as follows: each semester hour of credit
with a grade of A counts four quality points; B, three points; C, two points; D, one point. Degree
candidates must maintain a minimum grade point average of 3.000. Credits earned with less than
a “C” grade cannot be accepted as satisfying the requirements.

Grade Points Grading

Scale

Required Points Description

A 4.00 90-100 1647-1830 Excellent

B 3.00 80-89.99 1454-1646 Good

C 2.00 70-79.99 1281-1453 Satisfactory

D 1.00 60-69.99 1098-1280 Poor

F 0.00 below 60 1097 Failure

Discussion Board (350 Points) Grading Rubric

There are seven discussion boards worth 50
points each. Total points = 350 points.

All discussion boards are worth 50 points and have the following point assignment:

Initial post – worth 30 points:

• Summarizes the main points of the question(s) or article

Reply posts – worth 20 points each:

• Responds thoughtfully to at least two classmates

Chapter Quizzes (12x60 =780 Points)

Assignments (6* 50 Points each=300 points)

Research Proposal and Final Paper: 200 points

Final Exam (200 points)

LATE WORK
If you cannot submit work on time, please
contact me. All work not turned in on time will receive a 20% grade deduction prior to the work
being graded.
